content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was that at Power-On Reset, transients could cause the LCPLL (Low Power Phase-Locked Loop) to lock onto an unstable clock signal, particularly in QSGMII setups using the higher speed 6G SerDes. This instability could lead to improper functioning of the PHY (Physical Layer Device), necessitating the addition of an initial LCPLL reset to ensure stable operation.
